Description: Samsung’s 860 EVO SATA III 2.5" internal SSD delivers fast access to your data, with sequential read speeds up to 550 MB/s and sequential write speeds up to 520 MB/s. It is well suited for storing and rendering large-format files like 4K video and 3D data. The 2.5" form factor works with many notebooks and desktop PCs, and it uses the SATA III interface. A refined ECC (Error Correction Code) algorithm and MJX controller help provide high data transfer speeds. Key Features: Enhanced Performance - Speeds stay more consistent, even under heavy workloads and multitasking. With Intelligent TurboWrite technology, the 860 EVO reaches sequential writes of up to 520 MB/s* and sequential reads of up to 550 MB/s. The TurboWrite buffer size* increases from 12 GB to 78 GB for quicker file transfer. Boosted Endurance - Safely store and render large 4K videos and 3D data used by the latest applications, with up to 8x higher TBW (Terabytes Written)* than the previous 850 EVO. Smart Compatibility - Enjoy faster, smoother communication with your host system. The refined ECC* algorithm and new MJX controller deliver higher speeds, and improved queued trim boosts Linux compatibility. This advanced engineering makes the 860 EVO more compatible with your computing system. Form Factor - 2.5-inch size for desktop PCs and laptops.
